vulnerability.name: USN-5614-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5614-1 fixed a vulnerability in Wayland. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that Wayland incorrectly handled reference counting  certain objects. An attacker could use this issue to cause Wayland to  crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary  code.

statements.status_notes: Wayland could be made to crash or run programs. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
